name: What is the typical cost range for a whole house interior renovation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a whole house interior renovation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a whole house interior renovation in the Bay Area varies widely due to factors like the size of your home, the extent of the work, and your material selections. Minor cosmetic updates might start from $75,000 to $150,000, while extensive remodels involving structural changes, high-end finishes, and new systems can range from $200,000 to over $500,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for whole house interior renovations in the Bay Area range from $75,000 for minor updates to over $500,000 for extensive remodels, depending on scope and materials.
